title: Charles Daniel Webster and Adam Kramer, March 1929
location: 202 Luzerne Avenue, Baltimore, Maryland, United States
caption: Charles Daniel Webster (left) and Adam Kramer (right), photographed outside a brick building at 202 Luzerne Avenue in Baltimore, Maryland, in March 1929. The photograph was taken approximately four months before Adam married Charles's sister, Sue Catherine Webster, on July 27, 1929.

title: Florence Webster and Vernon Adams Seated on Steps
caption: Florence Melson Webster Adams (left) and her husband, Vernon L. Adams, seated together on the steps outside a brick building. Date and location unknown.

title: Florence Webster and Vernon Adams Outdoors
caption: Florence Melson Webster Adams (left) and her husband, Vernon L. Adams, standing together outdoors, dressed in coats and hats. Date and location unknown.

title: Florence Webster Adams and Eugene Webster
caption: Florence Melson Webster Adams (left) seated with her younger brother, Eugene Lee Webster (right), on a sofa. Date and location unknown.

title: Gravestone of Vernon L. Adams and Florence M. Adams
location: Moreland Memorial Park, Parkville, Baltimore County, Maryland, United States
caption: Shared bronze grave marker of Vernon L. Adams (1899–1974) and Florence M. Adams (1904–1979) at Moreland Memorial Park in Parkville, Maryland. The marker bears the inscription 'Together Forever.'

title: Sue Catherine Webster Standing on Front Steps
caption: Sue Catherine Webster standing on the front steps of a house, wearing a dark dress and Mary Jane shoes. Date and location unknown. Digitally restored from an original family photograph.

title: Adam Kramer and Sue Catherine Webster
caption: Adam Johannes Kramer (left) and Sue Catherine Webster (right) standing together outside a house. Adam wears a light-colored overcoat, while Sue wears a dark coat with a fur collar. Date and location unknown. Digitally restored from an original family photograph.

title: Gravestone of Addie Leola Daniel Webster
caption: Gravestone of Addie Leola Daniel Webster (1881–1922) at Woodlawn Cemetery, Baltimore, Maryland. The marker bears the inscription 'ADDIE L. WEBSTER' and 'MOTHER.' Her death certificate records her burial on April 28, 1922.

title: Daniel Family Gravestone – James F., Mary C., and Wilson B. Daniel
caption: Daniel family gravestone at Saint Johns Cemetery, Deal Island, Somerset County, Maryland. The marker commemorates James F. Daniel (1855–1927), Mary C. Daniel (1859–1910), and Wilson B. Daniel (1897–1918). Mary Catherine Wilson Daniel was the mother of Addie Leola Daniel Webster.

title: Daniel Family Home – 2010 Walbrook Avenue, Baltimore
caption: Photograph of the former Daniel family residence at 2010 Walbrook Avenue, Baltimore, Maryland, taken in the early 21st century. Mary Catherine Wilson Daniel (1859–1910) was living at this address when she died on October 4, 1910, according to her death notice published in The Baltimore Sun on October 5, 1910. The photograph shows the three-story rowhouse with boarded windows and doors and visible deterioration. The photograph's exact date and the building's subsequent history have not yet been established.

title: Gabriel Snead Webster Standing Outside a Building
caption: Full-length photograph of William Gabriel Snead Webster (1871–1939) standing on a sidewalk in front of a brick building and chain-link fence. He is wearing a dark suit, tie, and round eyeglasses. The location and date of the photograph have not been established.

title: Gabriel Snead Webster with Family Members
caption: Group photograph showing William Gabriel Snead Webster (1871–1939) standing outdoors with four other individuals, including three women or girls and a young child. The photograph was taken beside a building under a tree. The identities of the other individuals, location, and date remain to be confirmed.

title: Gravestone of Gabriel Snead Webster
caption: Gravestone of Gabriel Snead Webster (1871–1939) at Woodlawn Cemetery, Baltimore, Maryland. The marker is inscribed 'GABRIEL S. WEBSTER, 1871–1939, FATHER.'

title: Former Webster Family Home – Deal Island, Maryland
caption: Historical photograph of the former Webster family home in Deal Island, Maryland, associated with Gabriel Snead Webster, Addie Leola Daniel Webster, Florence Melson Webster, Susie Catherine Webster, Charles Daniel Webster, and Maynard Snead Webster. The house has since been demolished. The photograph date and demolition date are unknown.
location: Deal Island, Somerset County, Maryland, United States

title: Gravestones of William J. Webster and Susie A. Windsor Webster
caption: Gravestones of Susan A. Windsor Webster (1843–1911) and her second husband, William Jacob Webster (1836–1910), at Saint John's Cemetery, Deal Island, Somerset County, Maryland. Susan's gravestone is inscribed 'SUSIE A. WEBSTER' and 'MOTHER,' while William's is inscribed 'WILLIAM J. WEBSTER' and 'FATHER.' Susan's first husband, Gabriel S. Webster, died in 1871, several years after their marriage in 1865.

title: Anna Elizabeth Webster Todd and Major Carroll Todd Sr.
caption: Anna Elizabeth "Lizzie" Webster Todd (1868–1940) standing with her husband, Major Carroll Todd Sr. (1868–1944), outside a house. Photograph date and location unknown.

title: Gravestone of Anna Elizabeth Webster Todd
caption: Gravestone of Anna Elizabeth Webster Todd (1868–1940) at Sunny Ridge Memorial Park in Crisfield, Somerset County, Maryland.

title: Gravestone of Gabriel Snead Webster
caption: Gravestone of Gabriel S. Webster (1822–1871). The inscription records his death in 1871. Cemetery location to be confirmed.

title: Gravestone of Leah White Webster
caption: Gravestone of Leah White Webster (April 27, 1776 – January 1, 1857) at Saint Johns Cemetery, Deal Island, Somerset County, Maryland. The inscription identifies her as Leah Webster.

title: Gravestone of James Travers Daniel
caption: Gravestone of James Travers Daniel (February 14, 1830 – February 10, 1902), at St. John's Methodist Church Cemetery, Deal Island, Somerset County, Maryland.

title: Gravestone of William E. Kelly and Emma L. Kelly
caption: Shared gravestone of William E. Kelly (1870–1950) and Emma L. Kelly (1877–1939) at Woodlawn Cemetery, Baltimore, Maryland. The gravestone bears a Masonic square-and-compasses emblem.

Gravestone of Julia A. Daniel (1812–1893) at Saint Johns Cemetery, Deal Island, Somerset County, Maryland. The inscription identifies her as the daughter of Travers and Mary Daniel and records her birth on February 21, 1812. The death inscription indicates December 1893, although the exact day is difficult to read.

Gravestone of Jacob Parks (August 3, 1801 – September 29, 1885) at Saint Johns Methodist Church Cemetery, Deal Island, Somerset County, Maryland. Jacob Parks is identified in family genealogical research as the husband of Julia Ann Daniel (1812–1893).

Gravestone bearing the name Travers Daniel (1780–1861) at Daniel Family Cemetery, Wenona, Somerset County, Maryland. The fragments were photographed after the original gravestone had fallen and deteriorated. The cemetery contains several Daniel family burials, and none of its historic gravestones remain standing, according to firsthand family observations.

Gravestone of Gabraella Rowe (February 27, 1854 – September 30, 1868) at Daniel Family Cemetery, Wenona, Somerset County, Maryland. The inscription is heavily weathered but appears to preserve her birth and death dates. Family genealogical records identify her as the daughter of Gabriel H. Rowe and Eleanor Ellen Daniel.

title: Gravestone of David W. Daniel
location: Daniel Family Cemetery, Wenona, Somerset County, Maryland
caption: Gravestone of David W. Daniel (approximately 1813–1831) at Daniel Family Cemetery in Wenona, Somerset County, Maryland. The weathered inscription appears to record his death on September 26, 1831, in the nineteenth year of his age. David is identified in family genealogical research as a son of Travers Daniel and Mary L. Wallace.

title: Gravestone of Margaret Daniel Dix
location: St. Johns United Methodist Church Cemetery, Deal Island, Somerset County, Maryland
caption: Gravestone of Margaret Daniel Dix (approximately 1818–1888) at St. Johns United Methodist Church Cemetery, Deal Island, Somerset County, Maryland. The inscription records her death on October 15, 1888, in the 70th year of her age.

title: Gravestone of John Dix
location: Saint Johns Cemetery, Deal Island, Somerset County, Maryland
caption: Gravestone of John Dix (1814–1868) at Saint Johns Cemetery, Deal Island, Somerset County, Maryland. The inscription records his birth on November 15, 1814, and death on April 20, 1868, at the age of 53. John married Margaret Daniel on June 3, 1834, in Somerset County, Maryland.

title: William Daniel — 1884 Vice-Presidential Candidate
caption: Historical portrait of William Daniel (1826–1897), Maryland attorney, legislator, and Prohibition Party candidate for Vice President of the United States in 1884. The illustration is captioned 'Hon. William Daniel — Prohibition Candidate for Vice President.' The original artist and publication have not yet been identified.

title: Mary Catherine Webster and Joseph Lawrence Jackson Jr.
caption: Mary Catherine Webster (1916–1995) with Joseph Lawrence Jackson Jr. (1918–1992), photographed outdoors. Joseph is wearing a U.S. Army uniform. A National Jewish Welfare Board record identifies him as a Technical Sergeant during World War II. The photograph's date and location have not been established.

title: Mary Catherine Webster Outdoors
caption: Mary Catherine Webster standing outdoors in a light-colored dress with a bow at the neckline. Date and location unknown.

title: Portrait of Mary Catherine Webster
caption: Close-up portrait of Mary Catherine Webster wearing a necklace. Date unknown.

title: Wedding Portrait of Mary Catherine Webster and Joseph Lawrence Jackson Jr.
caption: Wedding portrait of Mary Catherine Webster and Joseph Lawrence Jackson Jr. Mary Catherine wears a wedding gown and veil, while Lawrence wears his United States Army uniform. Their wedding date and location remain to be established.

title: Mary Catherine Webster Seated Outdoors
caption: Mary Catherine Webster seated outdoors, wearing a dark suit with a floral corsage. Date and location unknown.

title: Mary Catherine Webster and Joseph Lawrence Jackson Jr.
caption: Mary Catherine Webster and Joseph Lawrence Jackson Jr. standing together outdoors, dressed in coats. Date and location unknown.

title: Mary Catherine Webster Holding a Baby
caption: Mary Catherine Webster holding an infant outside a brick building. The child's identity and photograph date have not been established.

title: Gravestone of Joseph Lawrence and Mary Catherine Jackson
caption: Shared gravestone of Joseph L. Jackson (1918–1992) and Mary C. Jackson (1916–1995) at Moreland Memorial Park, Maryland. The marker bears the inscription 'Together Forever.'
